intro.text: The garment Yumi wears for her rituals, put on her by her attendants after her ritual bath.
A traditional overgarment made from a double layer of heavy cloth, usually long-sleeved and found in many colours.

description.text: At the Shinzua Shopping Center, Yumi buys a dressy cardigan that reminds her of the top half of her usual tobok, though it is stiffer, shorter in body and sleeve, and closer fitting.

The yoki-hijo owns several bright ceremonial toboks and changes which one she wears according to the weekday, over a sash at the bust, a white wrap across the chest and loose leggings. Her attendants dress her in it.
